commentary.text: 90+10' Paul Tierney is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' Kyle Walker (Burnley) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.

90+7' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
90+6' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
90+6' Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Burnley.
90+4' Lucas Pires (Burnley) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Paul Tierney had an easy-decision to make.
90+3' Mikel Arteta has decided to make a change. Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) replaces Martin Odegaard.
90+3' A substitution has been made. Leandro Trossard goes off and Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) comes on.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Zian Flemming (Burnley) was quite harsh and Paul Tierney didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

88' Declan Rice (Arsenal) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
86' Paul Tierney blows his whistle after Lucas Pires (Burnley) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Arsenal win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

78' Substitution. James Ward-Prowse (Burnley) in, Florentino out.
77' Josh Laurent (Burnley) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Declan Rice (Arsenal) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
74' Zian Flemming (Burnley) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Arsenal have been awarded a free kick.
73' Here comes a substitution. Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) is brought on as a substitute for Eberechi Eze.
73' Today's match ends for Kai Havertz who will be replaced by Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal).
72' Riccardo Calafiori comes off the pitch to be replaced by Piero Hincapie (Arsenal).
71' Mike Jackson has decided to substitute Lesley Ugochukwu and he is replaced by Josh Laurent (Burnley).

69' Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) is able to continue to play.
68' Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
67' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
67' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

64' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
63' One of the players from Arsenal times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
63' Declan Rice (Arsenal) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
62' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Paul Tierney blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Arsenal.
60' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
59' 11:5 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 3:0.
57' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
57' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Kyle Walker (Burnley).
55' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance.
54' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
53' A cross by Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.

51' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) creates some space for himself and unleashes a strike from long range, but his effort sails just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
48' The Burnley players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
47' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
47' The attendance for today's match is 60274.

44' A short pass finds Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
42' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

40' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Burnley manage to earn a corner.
37' 1 - 0 Bukayo Saka takes over corner duties and expertly finds Kai Havertz (Arsenal), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the middle of the goal. The score is now 1:0.
37' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will take a corner kick.

37' Wow, what an escape. Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Arsenal.
35' PENALTY APPEAL after Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
35' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Bukayo Saka wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
32' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).

31' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
30' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Max Weiss.
28' That's a clear yellow card. Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) goes into the book.

27' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) meets a cross from the flank and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies totally wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
25' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) commits a rough foul. Paul Tierney stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to Arsenal.
24' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
24' The ball possession is 78:22. The number of shots on goal at present is 0:0.
22' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The linesman signals a throw-in for Arsenal.
21' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
20' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
19' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Paul Tierney signals. That's a free kick to Arsenal.
18' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
17' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
16' Paul Tierney has a clear sight and sees a foul from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).
15' OFF THE POST! Good play from Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes the left post!

14' Leandro Trossard slides a brilliant pass into Kai Havertz (Arsenal), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
14' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

13' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Arsenal force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
12' Unsporting behaviour by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal).
12' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender.

11' Gabriel (Arsenal) fails to find the target. The goalkeeper, rooted to the spot, watches on helplessly as the volley goes well wide of the right post. The goalkeeper rode his luck there. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.

11' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
10' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Arsenal are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
8' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Burnley will take a throw-in.
7' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
6' Declan Rice (Arsenal) plays a one-two with Bukayo Saka, but the move breaks down.
5' Arsenal enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

4' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Arsenal.

3' Florentino (Burnley) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the right post. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
2' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

2' Good clearance! Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. Burnley force a corner. They send men into the box.
2' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
2' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Burnley are going to take it.
